title: Natchez House Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Natchez House has a prime Seaside location only 377 feet to the beach access and directly across from the Westside pool. Incredible porches, outdoor dining for 14 under string lights, and two kings!
description_expanded: Description147 GRAYTON STREETKING, KING, QUEEN, 1 TWIN BUNK, TWIN/TRUNDLE (sleeps 10)Prime Location in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaNestled in the heart of Seaside, Florida, this striking coastal residence delivers an unforgettable 30A escape. Ideally positioned just 377 feet from private Seaside beach access and directly across from the community pool, the home offers unmatched convenience for beach days and poolside relaxation. Situated on a corner lot, guests will enjoy ample parking both in front of and alongside the home, making arrivals and departures seamless.Inviting Outdoor Living & Entertaining SpacesDesigned to embrace the coastal lifestyle, this home features expansive open-air porches on both levels and a central outdoor courtyard in the rear. The courtyard showcases a lighted outdoor dining area with seating for up to 14, perfect for group meals under bistro lights, along with two outdoor charcoal grills—ideal for evening cookouts after a day at the beach.Open-Concept Living, Dining & Gourmet KitchenInside, the home welcomes you with a bright, open-concept layout that seamlessly connects the living room, dining area, and gourmet kitchen—perfect for entertaining family and friends. The living room features a large leather sectional, offering a comfortable retreat after sun-filled days along 30A. The adjacent dining area seats eight guests comfortably, while the fully equipped kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, marble countertops, and generous cabinetry. Whether preparing a casual breakfast or a full coastal feast, the kitchen is designed to meet every need.First-Floor King Suite RetreatThe first-floor king bedroom provides a peaceful retreat with crisp linens, calming coastal tones, and an updated ensuite bathroom featuring a single vanity and tub/shower combination. This private suite offers the added luxury of direct porch access with outdoor seating for five—an ideal setting for morning coffee or quiet evenings.Spacious Upstairs Bedrooms & Private BalconiesUpstairs, the remaining bedrooms offer flexibility and comfort for families or groups. The second bedroom features a queen bed, flat-screen TV, small closet, and an ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination. Step outside to a private furnished balcony with bistro seating for two, perfect for evening nightcaps. The third bedroom comfortably accommodates up to four guests and includes a king bed, twin bed with trundle, and a large flat-screen TV. This room offers access to its own private balcony with bistro seating, as well as shared access to the spacious front porch. A shared hall bathroom with single vanity and tub/shower combination is located just off this room. The fourth bedroom features a custom-built twin bunk bed, ideal for younger guests.Thoughtful Extras & Added ComfortsAdditional conveniences include a stackable washer and dryer on the first floor, a second refrigerator located near the laundry area, and multiple outdoor gathering spaces throughout the property. With its unbeatable Seaside location, generous outdoor living areas, and thoughtfully designed interiors, this home offers the perfect setting for a memorable Seaside, Florida vacation.*5NT min Spring; 3NT Min Fall; 2NT Min Winter. Not available during Spring Break, Summer, & Fall Break. Must be 25 to rent and sign the registration. Natchez House is only available during non-demand times, Spring, Fall, and winter.FEATURES377 feet to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach access at Natchez Pavilion, one of the largest private residential beaches on 30ATwo outdoor charcoal grillsLighted outdoor dining area, ideal for evening gatheringsSecond refrigerator, perfect for added storage and entertainingAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote upon arrival, including 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued. A golf cart is considered a car, and golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
